name: POST /api/leadflow/records/:ref/close-lost - the SOP §15 loss capture
description:
Requires the reason code, the prospect OWN WORDING and the offer version discussed (c3bf29f3-da93-407b-8ecc-fdb35c245cdc#AC3), all three verified live at 400 when absent and 201 when complete.

WHY THE WORDING IS MANDATORY. A taxonomy tells you how often you lose on price; the sentence tells you what they actually said, and only one of those changes how the offer gets written. A paraphrase is the rep interpretation of the loss, which is the thing least likely to survive contact with the next deal.

WHY THE OFFER VERSION IS MANDATORY. A loss cannot be attributed to terms that have since changed. Without the version stamp, six months of losses aggregate into a number about an offer that no longer exists.

A FUTURE DATE ONLY WHEN ONE TRULY EXISTS. revisit_at is nullable on purpose: inventing a follow-up date to fill the field produces a nurture queue full of commitments the prospect never made, which is how re-engagement earns its reputation. The response says so rather than leaving the null looking like an omission.

SEVEN CODES FROM SOP §15 - NO_FIT, TIMING, BUDGET, FEATURE, RIVAL, TRUST, NO_REPLY - and an unrecognised one is refused rather than stored, because a loss reason nothing aggregates is a loss nobody learns from.

ONE CAPTURE PER RECORD, enforced by a unique constraint: a second call returns the existing capture rather than overwriting what was said the first time. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A capture with no prospect wording is refused
A capture with no offer version is refused

payload.prospect_wording: {{static:We just spent our budget on a van}}

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: an unrecognised loss code is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: reason_code must be one of NO_FIT, TIMING, BUDGET, FEATURE, RIVAL, TRUST, NO_REPLY
errorCases.when: an unrecognised loss code is supplied.

errorCases.message: prospect_wording is required - record what they actually said, not a paraphrase
errorCases.when: the prospect own words are missing.

errorCases.message: offer_version is required - a loss cannot be attributed to terms that have since changed
Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
